title: Brew a Potion
rawBody:
When you prepare a potion, write its name down and give it an appropriate rank. In general, students learn how to brew Dangerous potions starting in Year 3, Formidable in Year 5, and Extreme in Year 7. If a recipe has been researched, you can try brewing potions one rank higher at -2.

Envision which step you are taking (gathering ingredients, crushing, mixing, etc.), then, roll +cunning (skip creating a new track while you are still working on the same potion).

On a **strong hit**, mark progress. You manage to find the ingredients, or you successfully follow the correct brewing steps.
On a **weak hit**, you fail something, you breathe in a foul smell, you risk getting caught, or you burn yourself... Suffer -1 to momentum, spirit, health, or reputation.
On a **mis**, same as above, but you must choose to bottle your potion (you may no longer _Brew a Potion_ to progress on this track), or discard it.

title: Cast
rawBody:
When you cast a spell you Know outside of combat, roll +relevant skill. Take -2 for each year above, or +1 for each year below. You don't need to roll for _learned_ spells 3 years below your own \[Y4 -> Y1]. Add +2 if the spell is Learned.

If you cast a **Charm**, roll +Edge.
If you cast a **Defensive or Restorative Spell**, roll +Heart.
If you cast **Dark Arts**: Jinxes (instant effect), Hexes (short-term effect), or Curses (long-term effect), roll +Power.
If you cast **Transfiguration spell** (very short range), roll +Wits.

On a **strong hit**, the spell is successful, envision what happens and gain +1 momentum.
You may use the occasion to _Learn a Spell_.
On a **weak hit**, you cast the spell, but (pick one)...
* The effect isn't as powerful as it should be.
* The effect doesn't last as long as it should.
* You attract unwanted attention.
On a **miss**, _Pay the Price_. The spell misses (lose momentum), backfires (_Endure Harm or Stress_), draws attention (_Get Caught_)...

title: Face Danger
rawBody:
When you attempt something risky or react to an imminent threat, envision your action and roll. If you act...

* With speed, agility, or precision: Roll +edge.
* With charm, loyalty, or courage: Roll +heart.
* With aggressive action, forceful defense, strength, or endurance: Roll +power.
* With deception, stealth, or trickery: Roll +cunning.
* With expertise, insight, or observation: Roll +wits.

On a **strong hit**, you are successful. Take +1 momentum.
On a **weak hit**, you succeed, but face a troublesome cost. Choose one:
- You are delayed, loose advantage, or face a new danger: Suffer -1 momentum.
- You are tired or hurt: _Endure Harm_ (1 harm).
- You are dispirited or afraid: _Endure Stress_ (1 stress).
- You _Get Caught_ (1 reputation).
On a **mis**, you fail, or your progress is undermined by a dramatic and costly turn of events. _Pay the Price_.

title: Gather Information
rawBody:
When you search an area, ask questions, conduct an investigation, or follow a track, roll +wits. If you act within a community or ask questions of a person with whom you share a bond, add +1.

On a **strong hit**, you discover something helpful and specific. The path you must follow or action you must take to make progress is made clear.
Envision what you learn (_Ask the Oracle_ if unsure), and take +2 momentum.
On a **weak hit**, the information complicates your quest or introduces a new danger. Envision what you discover (_Ask the Oracle_ if unsure), and take +1 momentum.
On a **mis**, your investigation unearths a dire threat or reveals an unwelcome truth that undermines your quest. _Pay the Price_.

title: Investigate
rawBody:
When you investigate an object you learn more about a particular Point of Interest.

On a **strong hit**, you discover something helpful and specific. Ask 2 questions.
On a **weak hit**, the information isn't very specific, or you might miss a detail. Ask 1 question.
On a **miss**, you learn nothing useful and might have missed an important detail.

Some questions you could ask...

* Are there any traps?
* Is there any remaining magic here?
* Is there anything strange, physically about this?
* Is this similar to something I've seen before?
* Is there anything of use here?
* Or ask anything else...

title: Know Something
rawBody:
When you think it's reasonable that you might have read about something or that you know a spell, roll +wits.

For spells in your year, add +1 for every four months of school passed. (+1 in January, +2 in May).

Add +3 for earlier years (all spells 3 years below count as Known and do not need to be rolled).

On a **strong hit**, you Know the spell well, or you've read something useful.
On a **weak hit**, you don't Know the spell, or you've read something that will make things hard.
On a **miss**: You think you Know the spell, but you don't. Cast it as a -3. You haven't read about that.

On a **weak hit**, you achieve your objective, but not without cost. _Pay the Price_.
On a **miss**, you are defeated and the objective is lost to you. _Pay the Price_.

title: End the Fight
rawBody:
When you take decisive action to resolve the outcome of this fight, roll the challenge dice and compare to your progress. Momentum is ignored on this roll.

If you do not have initiative, count a strong hit as a weak hit, and weak hit as a miss.

On a **strong hit**, this foe is no longer in the fight. They are killed, out of action, flee, or surrender as appropriate to the situations and your intent (_Ask the Oracle_ if unsure).

title: Play Quidditch
rawBody:

Not all rolls should be +edge of course; you could use heart to plunge towards the ground and pull up at the last second, commit a foul unseen using cunning, use power to knock a bludger into the opposing Seeker, etc.

When you _Finish the Scene_, the snitch has been caught and the game is over.

On a **strong hit**, your team wins.
On a **weak hit**, either your team loses but you played well, or your yeam wins, but must _Pay the Price_.
On a **miss**, you lose dramatically, _Pay the Price_.

Alternatively, for shorter games, you can use the _Battle_ move to resolve the match in one roll. Use the appropriate stat for your position as defined page 5. You could also roll +wits if you shared a strategy with the team and they use it (even if you aren't on the team), or if you are the team captain.
